text:
I just finished going through all of my projects with @grok with @bot to extract all my art prompts from all my projects.

End Result:  13,425 prompts sorted and searchable.

I had to update its' computer once about a third of the way in, we timed out 2 times, and then it decided to work in smaller, more managable blocks of data within the projects and did not have any more issues. 

It took about 30 hours and sorted by subject and compiled it all for me.

Now I am going to revist some prompts from the past  and start another project with grok bot.

Seriously impressed at how well and efficiently this massive task was accomplished.
❤️‍🔥❤️‍🔥
#uto
